js: 'SETUP: ECHO=1 STREAM_DELAY=0.02 scripts/mock-openai.py 9291 &  then  scripts/chat-actions-setup.sh <owner token>  (dev instance on :8899). Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/chat-export.json --token <token> --base http://127.0.0.1:8899. Wipes every chat thread and folder of that instance first. Checks the Export entries exist and that their hrefs answer 200 with the right Content-Disposition; the file save itself is not clicked (a headless browser has no Downloads UI; the desktop app path is in the release notes).'

(async()=>{const j=async(u,b)=>(await fetch(u,{method:b===undefined?'GET':'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:b===undefined?undefined:JSON.stringify(b)})).json();const f=await j('/chat/api/folders');for(const x of f.folders)await j('/chat/api/folders/'+x.id+'/delete',{threads:'delete'});const t=await j('/chat/api/threads?archived=all');for(const x of t.threads)await j('/chat/api/threads/'+x.id+'/delete',{});const fo=await j('/chat/api/folders',{name:'Reports',defaults:{}});const th=await j('/chat/api/threads',{model_alias:'fake-echo',folder_id:fo.id});await (await fetch('/chat/api/threads/'+th.id+'/send',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({content:'Viele Grüße'})})).text();const t2=await j('/chat/api/threads',{model_alias:'fake-echo'});await (await fetch('/chat/api/threads/'+t2.id+'/send',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({content:'second thread'})})).text();window.__ids={folder:fo.id,thread:th.id,other:t2.id};return JSON.stringify(window.__ids)})()

js: (async()=>{const l=await (await fetch('/chat/api/threads')).json();const th0=l.threads.find(x=>x.title==='Viele Grüße');const thread=th0.id;const folder=th0.folder_id;const out=[];for(const [u,ct,cd,test] of [['/chat/api/threads/'+thread+'/export?format=md','text/markdown','attachment','# Viele Grüße'],['/chat/api/threads/'+thread+'/export?format=json','application/json','attachment','lmgw.chat.v1'],['/chat/api/folders/'+folder+'/export?format=md&archived=all','application/zip','attachment',null],['/chat/api/export?format=json&archived=all','application/zip','attachment',null]]){const r=await fetch(u);const h=r.headers.get('content-disposition')||'';const b=new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer());const txt=test?new TextDecoder().decode(b):'';const ok=r.status===200&&(r.headers.get('content-type')||'').startsWith(ct)&&h.startsWith('attachment; filename="')&&(!test||txt.includes(test))&&(test||(b[0]===0x50&&b[1]===0x4b));out.push(u+' -> '+r.status+' '+h+' '+b.length+'B '+(ok?'OK':'BAD'));}window.__exp=out;return out.join('\n')})()
